reviews.reviewbody: Is responsible for this compilation a genuine thank you from me for the laughs and knowing the internet will keep the comedy of Norm MacDonald available.
Torrent does not seem to include all files. BUT.... thank you for archiving these. Just requires solo downloads it seems
This is amazing man thank you.
There will never again be another Norm Macdonald, there will be something else, like a Marc Norman if you can do without d's or l's, but not another #--- #--d---ld.
